verdict.rationale: WorkOS AuthKit documents enrolling users in multi-factor authentication, which can be enabled from the Authentication page in the WorkOS dashboard, and the pricing page lists MFA as included in AuthKit. This covers the core requirement of making MFA available and turning it on. However, the evidence does not name TOTP authenticator apps as the factor type, and it says nothing about backup or recovery codes or step-up enforcement for sensitive actions. Missing for 10: explicit TOTP authenticator-app support, backup/recovery codes, step-up MFA enforcement, independent or hands-on corroboration.
